name: autopsy and cause of death overview
title: After a death: any coroner indication makes it a medicolegal case under the Coroner's Act; an expected natural death is certified by the doctor, who writes the cause of death in the WHO format, and a hospital autopsy needs informed authorization from the estate trustee or next of kin in order

root.title: A patient has died: does the coroner need to know?
lines: call the coroner if ANY: family concerned about care · sudden and unexpected (no potentially fatal illness) · unnatural (accident, suicide, homicide) · death on a psychiatry ward · maternal death · seizure disorder · Children's Aid involved in a child's death

groups.title: YES: coroner's case
lines: sudden and unexpected, or any indication above
